android_local.name: AionEndlessRun-0.17.1-android-arm64-x64.apk
android_local.provenance_note: Stable-signed APK exported locally from this application commit. Later commits only record package metadata and delivery evidence; gameplay, scenes, resources and project settings match this commit.

proven_causes: The enlarged main page used a ScrollContainer and could overflow.
Saved explicit language preference took priority over browser/OS detection.
limits_and_assumptions: The user device save was not available: why Italian was originally saved cannot be proved. A documented legacy save fixture reproduces the reported Italian/light/200% combination.
Browser Intl locale cannot guarantee the underlying OS language when browser and OS differ. Native uses OS locale.
The browser harness seeds settings and records only; the running world, RNG, enemies, physics and inventory are not injected.
Some historical model suites still cover the dormant contact-attack API. Current user-facing scene/browser tests assert pistol inputs and no melee animation.
Physical Poco/iPhone/Xbox/PS testing and Apple Developer ID/iOS distribution signing are not available.
Live production, CI native and public-package checks are recorded separately after completion.
browser_candidate_note: 34 browser checks ran on the 0.17.1 candidate before the final translated gamepad-help correction. Source tests cover all eleven corrected help strings. Final-build and live checks are recorded after completion.

ci_candidate_0170.cause: All real native inputs passed; image gate referenced obsolete android-melee.png. The 0.17.1 gate checks actual fire/reload images. No 0.17.0 release was published.

reused_visual_fixtures: Two illustrated flora fixtures originate in the 0.17.0 renderer; identical scenery/hero/prop art is retained.
